topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I don't usually bother with late-night flyers, but there's something about this one that makes me take the call. Says his plane's delayed, missed some big shindig he was supposed to hit. Could've been any Joe with a sob story, but this one's got a twinge of real in his voice. Tone's off, like he ain't used to being the one stuck in the waiting game. Tells me it's not just any party, some kind of high-stakes dinner with folks who could make or break a man's career. I can almost picture the sweat under his collar, the way his eyes dart around the airport, looking for a way out that ain't there. Says he needs a plan, fast. I suppose that's why they call me. Got my coat, heading out into the rain. We'll see what we can dig up.
